concept.subject: A great round-crowned tree in white blossom on a grassy hill under a pale sky, between two smaller blossoming trees at the edges.
concept.composition: The great crown spreads over the middle of the board with its trunk on the hill line just below; the smaller trees stand at the left and right edges; the hill slopes gently down to the right at a little over half the height and its meadow fills the lower half.
concept.layout: 137 round pegs; the first level with green pegs. Pegs trace the crown's outline and fill it with a lattice of blossoms, with a peg on the trunk; peg lines run along the hill at the tree's foot and in a V below it. Rings of pegs with three blossoms inside mark the side trees, each over a solid mound of the hill sloping toward the middle. Petal streams blow from the crown toward the upper corners, two tufts with a peg in the middle sit in the meadow and low lines leave the lower corners to the flippers.

background.prompt: A photo of a great round-crowned tree in white blossom on a green hill under a pale blue-gray sky. Its crown fills the middle of the picture, from about 29 to 70 percent of the width and from about a sixth to a little over half the height, its trunk standing on the hill line at about three fifths of the height just right of the center. Two smaller blossoming trees stand at the edges: one cut by the left edge, reaching a seventh of the width, from about a fifth to a little over half the height; one at the right edge from about 83 percent of the width, from a third to three fifths of the height. The hill line runs across at about 56 percent of the height on the left, sloping down to about 63 percent on the right; below it a meadow fills the picture.

picture.title: Three cherry blossom trees on a lush green hill under a blue sky.
picture.author: Manfredo Mozzarella
